purpose: ERP strategy parameter governance. This registry documents parameter families; it does not approve or optimize values.

entries.effect: Maps CSI300 ERP percentile to the total A-share equity waterline.
entries.required_evidence: Walk-forward comparison of waterline curves, drawdown and turnover.

entries.effect: Maps HSI ERP percentile to Hong Kong equity deployment when HSI ERP is available.
entries.required_evidence: Separate Hong Kong ERP history and walk-forward evaluation.

entries.effect: Caps core index exposure after all allocation logic has run.
entries.required_evidence: Concentration limit approved by the portfolio owner.

entries.effect: Moves a bounded portion of HS300 core-cap release to already-qualified A-share satellite targets; any unused amount remains cash.
entries.required_evidence: Walk-forward comparison against cash release, including turnover, concentration and satellite-entry diagnostics.

entries.effect: Controls ERP regime boundaries, aggressive sleeve share and alpha opportunity budget.
entries.required_evidence: Joint walk-forward sensitivity with cash weight, drawdown and turnover.

entries.effect: Converts relative-value recommendation grades to cross-bucket allocation scores.
entries.required_evidence: Monotonicity and spread sensitivity; no grade-specific curve fitting.

entries.effect: Sets the relative priority of eligible A-share satellite buckets before normalization.
Limits single-bucket and correlated growth-bucket exposure.
entries.required_evidence: Concentration and correlation budget approved by the portfolio owner.

entries.effect: Gates a bucket on its primary anchor and applies small pairwise tilts only after both anchors qualify.
entries.required_evidence: Ablation test against an anchor-only strategy.

entries.effect: Introduces an explicit strategy-state cycle: forced exit starts waiting, and the configured percentile clears it.
entries.required_evidence: Threshold sensitivity, hit-rate and turnover analysis by bucket.

entries.effect: Temporarily scales an otherwise eligible bucket from short-term deviation and five-day change.
entries.required_evidence: Ablation against overlay-disabled strategy and one-variable multiplier sensitivity.

entries.effect: Allocates the defensive style budget between 300 value and 300 growth.
entries.required_evidence: Value-growth pair history with rolling out-of-sample checks.

entries.effect: Sets Hong Kong pool size and HSI ERP regime behavior.
entries.required_evidence: Validated HSI ERP data and cross-market allocation study.

entries.effect: Blocks or warns on stale, inconsistent or non-conserving inputs and outputs.
entries.required_evidence: Operational reliability tests, not return optimization.

entries.effect: Maps observed holdings into strategy buckets; it must not change the model's standard reference allocation.

entries.path: index-compare analysis.ma_window / trend_windows / percentile_levels / score weights
entries.effect: Generates the primary relative-value recommendations consumed by ERP execution.
entries.required_evidence: Causal recomputation and walk-forward validation; all-history percentiles are not valid historical inputs.
